source: Owner directions, Estates at Indian Head concept set, 2026-09-30 / 2026-10-01

rules.rule: Draw and write plans with the DXF CAD tools (packages/cad-plot); the DXF is the master.
Plans must be complete, exact and within accepted tolerance; no on-sheet or reported excuses for incompleteness.
Satisfy the DPIE Design Review Checklist (08/25/2021) and Submittal Checklist (05/2017) line by line, including sight distance (item 10) and DA map + computations (items 6-7).
Use the prior approved plan's geometry exactly (street, cul-de-sac shape, houses, courts, drives, walks) except the utility layout.
No labels, notes or schedule titles citing the prior plan; geometry stays.
Lead walks complete (front door to drive, joined) and drawn heavier than drives, labelled.
Mains stop at the last service tap; capped (blow-off / terminal manhole) and labelled.
Every lot's W.H.C. and S.H.C. drawn from a tap on the main to the house, labelled; never under drive, apron, walk, stoop, culvert or ESD cell (verified geometrically).
Storm drainage cyan, ESD magenta, water blue, sewer green; no water/sewer on the SWM sheet; no criss-crossing.
Street sheet carries stationing, bearings, curve table, existing ground, PGL with vertical curves, EP elevations and the DPW&T pavement section.
Label every road inside the plan view.
One L.O.D. around the full site on every plan sheet, heavy black long dash with 'LOD' inline (Yocum convention).
Hold the L.O.D. 8-15 ft (10 ft) inside rear property lines and highway frontage; only R/W, entrance, highway lanes and WSSC easement cross.
Show super silt fence on the down-gradient L.O.D. and the stabilized construction entrance.
Existing and proposed contours on all plan sheets.
Adjoining existing structures shown and labelled EXISTING from the county building layer.
Rear yard applies to every lot line opposite the frontage.
Micro-bioretention (M-6) section on the SWM and detail sheets.
Drainage area map covers the whole contributing area to the divide and outfall.
Cover carries the subdivision as of record (no buildings) at the bottom.
Every label clearly on its property or on a leader to what it describes; no overprint, duplicate or redundant labels.
No 'survey to confirm' language on finished plans.
One vertical datum on the plans (NAVD 88); convert grades from older datums (WSSC: less 1.6 ft at Estates at Indian Head), never mix them under one symbol.
Use an approved plan's finished floor (converted to the plan datum) over the street-plus-2-ft estimate.
Street lights are LED; older-plan positions may be reused, the fixture is not.
Rear-yard M-6 cell takes roof and rear yard only, drainage area held to 20,000 sf (MDE 5.4.3); front yard, driveway and walk go to the street practice; BMP impervious equals lot coverage.
Check outfall velocity at the 10- and 100-yr flows at the swale grade, off-site inflow included; specify lining on exceedance.

Mark OUTSTANDING: downstream capacity, geotechnical field work (MDE TM No. 7), problematic-soil confirmation, adjacent-owner affidavit, updated NRI/TCP, and existing mains without sizes/inverts (A-14). Cite USDA Web Soil Survey for desktop soils.
Steep slopes from the County steep-slope layer (PGAtlas L13), drawn with 100 ft beyond the property; supersedes the 9/30 Estates no-steep-slopes direction (owner 2026-10-01).
Cite the plat's dedication area; report a differently-closing drawn R/W beside it, do not substitute it.
